summary: 35 boot canaries run in the daily run instead of every pull request; the REQUIRED mail canaries and the canary harness self-tests stay per pull request

replay.detail: CI selection only; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, wire or harness change. .config/daily-only.filterset gains one line; pull requests, merge groups and local runs leave those 35 tests out, and the daily-tests shards run them at full scale.

manual.detail: No manual step. Run them locally with CI_TEST_LANE=daily bash scripts/ci-nextest run -E '<the filter>'.

recovery.detail: Remove the line to put them back on every pull request.
